SYNTHETIC: an invented trial-monitoring report written for the corpus builder tests. No real person, state or case.

Fairness report: the trial of Dario Melk (invented), Republic of Ostravia (invented)

Summary

Dario Melk, a blogger who wrote about local elections, was charged with spreading false news through his website.

The monitor observed that the defendant was kept in a police station for four days before any judge saw him.

At the first hearing the prosecution read its indictment aloud, and the judgment later repeated long passages of it word for word.

Assessment

In the monitor's assessment, the delay before the first appearance breached the requirement of prompt judicial control.
